candidate.title: snRNA-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina snRNA-Seq schematic, from Cell suspension through isolation and sorting of nuclei, first-strand/cDNA synthesis, cDNA PCR, tagmentation, and Gap repair and PCR to the indexed Enrichment-ready fragment. The retained route is the single-nucleus route; the upper-left Single cell → RNA AA(A)n inset explains the analyte, and the separated supernatant has no downstream route. This is the depicted oligo(dT)/template-switching cDNA and Nextera XT architecture within snRNA-Seq, supported by Lacar et al., not a claim about every snRNA-Seq platform. Smart-seq2 is an embedded component, not another target method. Div-Seq and Nuc-seq are unshown similar methods. The Lacar paper supports plate-based Smart-seq2 for NE nuclei and separate C1 handling of HC nuclei; the PNG does not establish that these platform operations occur serially. Sequencing/analysis, pooling, antibody staining and detailed tissue preparation are not depicted operations.

operations.label: First strand synthesis
operations.description: Copy accessible poly(A)-bearing nuclear RNA into a complementary first DNA strand associated with the depicted oligo(dT)/adaptor. operations.mechanism: Adaptor-associated oligo(dT)-primed reverse transcription, interpreted from the A/T pairing and the First strand synthesis label. The collection schematic explicitly names reverse transcriptase.
operations.information_effect: Transfers transcript sequence information from nuclear RNA into cDNA and adds a primer-associated handle. Poly(A)-dependent priming limits the represented substrate class; the icon does not establish capture of every nuclear RNA.

unknowns.question: Does the dark terminal G in the PNG denote exactly the LNA modification labelled in the same-target collection schematic for the particular C1 and plate-based implementations? The PNG lacks that legend, and Lacar's inspected full text does not specify the oligo sequence/chemistry for each platform. Platform-specific oligo specifications would resolve this; the shared template-switching architecture does not require asserting uniform modification chemistry.

checks.rationale: Accept at the declared schematic/implementation scope. Independent image inspection accounts for all seven operations, the genuine nuclei/supernatant separation, every retained material connection, and the indexed DNA endpoint. Nuclear RNA is the biological target, RNA is copied during first-strand synthesis, and transcript-derived cDNA is the library carrier. The explanatory whole-cell RNA inset is retained as context without an invented parallel library. The paper supports a compatible plate-based implementation; the candidate does not force its separate C1 implementation into that route. Paper identities and evidence levels are correctly separated, and the remaining modification question is nonblocking.
